r13_contract.comparisonModel: The strength of a framing member is dependent upon the fixity that is provided at its supports. Fixity can be assumed where framing members are either continuous through the support or attached to a supporting section with a connection bracket. In other cases, simple support is to be assumed unless the connection can be demonstrated to provide significant rotational restraint. Fixity is to be ensured at the support of any framing which terminates within an ice-strengthened area.

test_cases.rationale: Continuous-through-support framing is represented with fixed support.
Connection bracket provides a source-grounded basis for fixed support.
Without a fixity basis, simple support is conservatively assumed.
Demonstrated rotational restraint plus evidence provides a basis for fixed support.
Fixed support is claimed without continuity, bracket, or demonstrated restraint evidence.
Rotational restraint is claimed but significant-restraint evidence is missing.
Framing terminating within an ice-strengthened area is represented as simply supported.
Member support node is not connected through the frozen hasMemberSupport path.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
